content.tex: Section B
MODELLING STREET LIGHTS
You are advised to spend no longer than 45 minutes on this section.
In this task you will be modelling how to place lights on paths.
In this task:

\(\bullet\) paths are straight \(\bullet\) lights are shown as large dots \(\bullet\) lights shine on an area that is a circle called the circle of light \(\bullet\) lights must shine on all parts of the path \(\bullet\) lights are placed as far apart as possible.
In this task you will find Pythagoras’theorem useful.
